svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Body: a sealed PVC cap about 104 mm across and 90 mm tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Socket: a 75 mm PVC socket coupling cut to 40 mm, solvent-welded under

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the body, centred. The tube top slides into it up to the body.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inside: the ultrasonic ranger, transducer face down and flush with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the inside of the socket; the 10 k NTC beside it; two stainless wet

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: probe pins 10 mm below the face, 36 mm apart; a cable gland on top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pot the electronics, keeping the transducer face and the probe tips

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: push over the tube top; two stainless screws through the socket

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into the tube's pilot holes. Undo them to lift the head for cleaning.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Transducer face 300 mm below the road.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the socket slides fully onto a tube offcut; probe tips clean.
